:::{#lem-deriv-log-density}
#### Derivative of a density through its logarithm

Let $\p(\vx \mid \param)$ be a density
that is positive and differentiable in a scalar parameter $\param$.
Then its derivative with respect to $\param$
is the derivative of its logarithm times the density:

$$\deriv{\param}\p(\vx \mid \param) = \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param)$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-deriv-log-density, worked in @sol-deriv-log-density.

:::
